In this React Native + Expo p5 learning app, there's a "Run" button on the exercise page. The user wants a long-press on the Run button to show the reference search modal.

Please research `/workspaces/learn-p5/src/app/learn/[course]/[id].tsx`:
1. Find the Run button (search for "Run", "handleRun", "onRun", "running", "isRunning"). Report file path + line numbers and the full JSX of the button (~15 line window). Show whether it has `onLongPress` already and what `onPress` does.
2. Find any existing reference search modal/sheet usage on this page (search for "searchVisible", "SearchOverlay", "openRef", "ref", "router.push('/ref'", "search"). Does the page already import or render `<SearchOverlay>`? Does it route to `/ref`? Report what's wired today.
3. Show the imports at the top of the file and the state declarations related to run/search.

Also check `/workspaces/learn-p5/src/components/SearchOverlay.tsx` exists and its props (visible, onClose, onSelectSymbol) so we know how to mount it.

Report file paths + line numbers + code excerpts. Read only, no edits.
Let me research the file and relatedcomponents.

47: type ExerciseAction =
48:  | { type: "LOAD_START" }
49:  | { type: "LOAD_DONE"; exercise: ExerciseType | null; course: string; id: string }
50:  | { type: "LOAD_ERROR"; error: string }
51:  | { type: "SET_CODE"; code: string }

53:  | { type: "APPEND_CODE"; text: string; cursorOffset?: number }
54:  | { type: "RUN_START" }

56:  | { type: "EXERCISE_COMPLETE" }
57:  | { type: "TASK_COMPLETE"; taskIndex: number };

59: function exerciseReducer(state: ExerciseState, action: ExerciseAction): ExerciseState {
60:  switch (action.type) {
61:  case "LOAD_START":
62:  return { ...state, loading: true, error: null };
63:  case "LOAD_DONE": {
64:  const ex = action.exercise;
65:  const baseCode = ex?.startingCode ?? "";
66:  const hasSetup = /function\s+setup\s*\(/.test(baseCode);
67:  const hasDraw = /function\s+draw\s*\(/.test(baseCode);
68:  const startingCode = !hasSetup || !hasDraw
69:  ? 'function setup() {\n createCanvas(400, 400);\n}\n\nfunction draw() {\n background(20);\n}\n'
70:  : baseCode;
71:  return {
72:  ...state,
73:  loading: false,
74:  exercise: ex ? { ...ex, startingCode } : null,
75:  startingCode,
76:  code: startingCode,
77:  error: null,
78:  };
79:  }
80:  case "LOAD_ERROR":
81:  return { ...state, loading: false, error: action.error };
82:  case "SET_CODE":
83:  return { ...state, code: action.code };
84:  case "RESET_CODE":
85:  return { ...state, code: state.startingCode };
86:  case "APPEND_CODE":
87:  return { ...state, code: state.code + action.text };
88:  case "RUN_START":
89:  return { ...state, isRunning: true };
90:  case "RUN_DONE":
91:  return { ...state, isRunning: false };
92:  case "EXERCISE_COMPLETE":
93:  return { ...state, completed: true };
94:  case "TASK_COMPLETE": {
95:  const completedTasks = [...state.completedTasks, action.taskIndex];
96:  const hasMoreTasks = state.exercise?.tasks && action.taskIndex < state.exercise.tasks.length - 1;
97:  return {
98:  ...state,
99:  completedTasks,
100:  currentTaskIndex: hasMoreTasks ? action.taskIndex + 1 : state.currentTaskIndex,
101:  completed: !hasMoreTasks,
102:  };
103:  }
104:  default:
105:  return state;
106:  }
107: }
